The '''2008–09 Danish Superliga''' was the 19th season of [[Danish Superliga]] league championship, which determines the winners of the [[List of Danish football champions|Danish football championship]], governed by the [[Danish Football Association]]. The season started on 19 July 2008 and ended on 31 May 2009. The defending champions were [[AaB Fodbold|Aalborg BK]].

The Danish champions qualified for the [[2009–10 UEFA Champions League]] qualifying round. Runners-up and 3rd placed team qualified for [[2009–10 UEFA Europa League]] qualifying rounds. 11th and 12th placed teams were relegated to the [[Danish 1st Division|1st Division]]. The 1st Division champions and runners-up were promoted to the Superliga.
==Promotion and relegation==
The following teams were promoted to Superliga after the end of [[2007–08 Danish 1st Division|the 2007–08 season]]:
* [[Vejle Boldklub|Vejle BK]] (winners)
* [[SønderjyskE Fodbold|SønderjyskE]] (runners-up)

The following teams were relegated from Superliga after the end of [[2007–08 Danish Superliga|the 2007–08 season]]:
* [[Viborg FF]] (11th placed)
* [[Lyngby Boldklub|Lyngby BK]] (12th placed)
